values.note: 'Most campsites can be reserved from May through October' (2026: May 1 - October 25; 2027: May 7 - October 31), up to 365 days ahead and at least one day before arrival; 'Unreserved sites are available on a first come, first served basis', and outside the reservable season the campground is first-come only. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/FortFrederick/Camping.aspx ('Most campsites can be reserved from May through October ... Unreserved sites are available on a first come, first served basis.'; 'Check in for family campsite guests is 3 p.m. and check out is 1 p.m.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/fort-frederick-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380109 (Booking Window: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.'; 2026/2027 Reservable Dates), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/fort-frederick-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380109 (all 27 family sites are 'Campsite Non-Electric') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/FortFrederick/Camping.aspx ('There is no potable water in the campground'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DNR: '29 campsites equipped with a stone dust camping pad, picnic table, fire ring and lantern post' (the booking site lists 27 non-electric sites, 16 of them 50 ft, the rest 30-40 ft), plus four youth group sites.

No potable water in the campground: water and a dumpster are by the railroad tracks, 3/5 mile away. Portable toilets in the campground from the first Saturday in May to the first Sunday in November; a comfort station with flush toilets and rinse-off stations is by the fort parking lot.

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/FortFrederick/Camping.aspx ('Portable toilets are located in the campground the first Saturday in May to the first Sunday in November. A comfort station with flush toilets and rinse off stations is available near the parking lot for the fort. There is no potable water in the campground. Potable water and a dumpster for campsite guests are located near the railroad tracks, 3/5 of a mile from the campground.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DNR's Fort Frederick camping page and the MD booking site: 29 sites (27 on the booking site, to 50 ft), non-electric, reservable May-October up to 365 days ahead but not same-day, unreserved sites first-come; no potable water in the campground (3/5 mile away), portable toilets seasonally, flush toilets at the fort lot. Season (manual) consistent. Fees left (manual 2026-10-12). Not stated: weekend/holiday minimums (left inherited). Note kept (AWH firsthand).
flags: Phone: entry has none; DNR gives 'Contact: 301-842-2155' for Fort Frederick State Park (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/fortfrederick.aspx).
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/FortFrederick/Camping.aspx.
